player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko Memory Game.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛtumi akɔ so ama wo ho dɔ nkrataa pii sen wo pɛpɛfo.
Wo berɛ mu no, wo bɛhwehwɛ nkrataa mmienu na wo bɛkyerɛw wo nkrataa no mu nsɛm ne nkrataa no kwan ne nkrataa no nkyɛn dodow no sɛ '[0 1 1 0]', baako a ɛwɔ nkrataa no mu wɔ nkyɛn 0 ne dodow 1, na nkrataa no mu wɔ nkyɛn 1 ne dodow 0.
Sɛ nkrataa no mmienu no yɛ pɛ, wo bɛnya akontabuo baako na nkrataa no bɛda adi. Sɛ wɔnnyɛ pɛ, nkrataa no bɛdan akyi adi, e.g. '.'.
Agɔ no bɛba awiee bere a nkrataa pii no nyinaa aba pɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsakrae a enni mu. Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} antumi amfa ɔkwan pa biara amma wɔ ntweaseɛ no so.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Nkɔso a enni mu. Odifo {player_id} paw baabi a ɛboro ne kwan so.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} paw krataa koro no ara mprenu.
invalid_move.already_matched: Nkɔso a enni mu. Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} paw krataa biako anaa mmienu no nyinaa a wɔadi kan aka ho asɛm dedaw.

game_message.cards_match: Nkrataa a Player {player_id} hwehwɛɛ no wɔ nkyɛn [{r1} {c1}] ne [{r2} {c2}] no yɛ pɛ!
game_message.cards_no_match: Nkrataa a Player {player_id} hwehwɛɛ no nyɛ pɛ. Nkrataa a ɛwɔ nkyɛn [{r1} {c1}] ne [{r2} {c2}] no yɛ {pos1} ne {pos2} sɛnea ɛte biara.

outcome.draw: Ná agumadifo no nyinaa wɔ nkrataa abien a edi nsɛ.
outcome.turn_limit: Bere a wɔbɛhwɛ nkrataa no aba awiee. Agɔ no aba awiee. Player 0 nyaa akontabuo {score_0}, Player 1 nyaa akontabuo {score_1}.
